key_insight: QuTOP uses offline oracle configurations to guide joint hardware and compiler-setting selection, avoiding the limitations of choosing a device first.
engineering_relevance: The framework targets higher circuit execution fidelity with low selection latency and no iterative online configuration search.
method: Build QuOPTBench by exhaustively searching configurations for 268 quantum circuits.
Use an LLM to extract transferable configuration-selection rules from sampled circuits.
Combine these rules with predictors trained on enumerated configuration data.
evidence_signal: Evaluation of ten representative LLMs found vanilla models far from the oracle, while QuTOP achieved the strongest overall quality–latency balance among evaluated baselines.
watch_item: Generalization to unseen circuit families or changing hardware calibration requires validation, and offline exhaustive search adds preparation cost.
paper_title: Turning Quantum Compiler Configuration Selection Upside Down: A Top-Down Paradigm
